subject: SOC2: staff training roster & offboarding verification — Brightfield
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@brightfield.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audit@brightfield.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — training roster and offboarding verification

Hi Jasmine,

We're starting the fieldwork for Brightfield's SOC 2 review next week. As part of the personnel controls sampling, the auditor team asked for: 1) a redacted staff roster with hire dates and hire type (FT/contractor) for any employee who had access to production systems in the past 18 months; 2) a report showing completion dates for the annual security training for that cohort; and 3) a short extract from your offboarding logs showing accounts deactivated and device return entries for any leavers in the sample window.

Can you provide those artifacts by end of day Thursday 3/23 PST? If any of these are sensitive, a redacted CSV or PDF is fine — we just need the fields called out above. Also include the chain-of-custody for the background check evidence for sampled hires (name + redacted id + check completed date).

Thanks — apologies for the short notice. Let me know if you need a point of contact on the audit team.

Regards,
Elena Morris
Senior IS Audit Manager
Brightfield Health

[Contact: +1 415 555 0198]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@brightfield.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — training roster and offboarding verification

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up. We can gather these artifacts. Quick clarifications before we pull the exports:

- Sample window: you mentioned 18 months — to confirm, are we using 2026-09-01 to 2028-02-29 (inclusive)?
- For background checks, do you need vendor reports (third-party vendor reference number) or a redacted summary (name, check type, completed date)? We typically provide redacted summaries for SOC artifacts.
- Offboarding: do you need deprovision timestamps for cloud accounts only, or also on-prem access and laptop return logs?

I'm looping in Marissa (HR) and Sean (Security) for the extracts. We should be able to deliver a redacted CSV roster and a training export by EOD Thu; offboarding logs may require a short follow-up with timestamps.

Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: none]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morris <elena@brightfield.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — training roster and offboarding verification

Thanks, Jasmine. Confirming the sample window Elena called out (2026-09-01 to 2028-02-29) works for HR exports. We'll provide: 

- staff_roster_redacted.csv: columns = role, hire_date (YYYY-MM-DD), employment_type (FT/Contractor), location (country only), office_access_flag (Y/N). Names will be pseudonymized to "redacted-###" but we will include an internal mapping (redacted for external transfer) for the audit team if they need identity verification under NDA.

- training_completion_export.pdf: generated from the LMS showing module names and completion dates for the sample cohort.

- offboard_audit_log_excerpt.xlsx: contains deprovision timestamps for cloud IAM and device_return flag for leavers in the sample.

Sean will attach the redacted background-check summary separately (vendor reference + check type + completed date). We'll upload the files to the Brightfield evidence Drive folder and paste links below.

Marissa Cole
Director, People Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: staff_roster_redacted.csv (preparing)]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

1) staff_roster_redacted.csv (redacted-ids in column A)
2) training_completion_export.pdf (LMS export filtered to sample window)
